common_sample_exclusion: exclude validation row whose event IDs intersect training-row event IDs; preserve all old coverage and version gates
old_evidence_limit: The previous fit did not record contemporaneous runner hash, row probabilities, or feature matrices. Unavailable direct comparisons remain unavailable; reconstructed outputs are labeled as such.
reproduction_gate: Proceed to increment fits only if all directly comparable old outputs match and any difference is explained; unrecorded old fields are limitations, not fabricated comparisons.
l2_meaning: coefficient multiplying non-intercept L2 penalty in existing IRLS; larger value is stronger regularization, not inverse-C
model: existing per-symbol logistic implementation and standardization; 0.5 classification threshold; independent selection by validation balanced accuracy, ties to stronger L2
text: original SEC-only event text, original training-only TF-IDF vocabulary and IDF; no cleaning or clipping change
probability_metric: mean squared error of upward probability against binary label (Brier score)
scope: reused-validation retrospective development only, with June-July 2026 contamination preserved; no independent test, trading, or formal M5 evaluation
